options.xml:
<match:request.method value="AKAMAI_TRANSLATE AKAMAI_PURGE" result="false">
                    <assign:extract-value>
                        <variable-name>HSIM_1</variable-name>
                        <location>Cookie</location>
                        <location-id>__token__</location-id>
                        <location-id-prefix-match>off</location-id-prefix-match>
                        <separator>=</separator>
                        <add-prefix>none</add-prefix>
                        <add-suffix>none</add-suffix>
                    </assign:extract-value>
                    <!-- Verify token from query string -->
                    <auth:browser.token>
                        <hmac-algo>SHA256</hmac-algo>
                        <escape-hmac-inputs>on</escape-hmac-inputs>
                        <verify>
                            <key>57153d9ab7a20df715487bcfb9ec63cc918f2da76c0286b51d71d26960031024</key>
                            <url>%(AK_URL)</url>
                            <token>%(HSIM_1)</token>
                            <salt>%(PMUSER_UA)</salt>
                            <!--disable automatic error responses -->
                            <failure-response>on</failure-response>
                            <!--extract the result of this verification into TOKENXXX_* variables -->
                            <variable-prefix>PM_TOKEN1</variable-prefix>
                        </verify>
                    </auth:browser.token>
</match:request.method>
